verdict.rationale: Readiness tracking is a fair question for a compliance-automation product, but the pack never documents a per-framework readiness view or a single audit-ready percentage. The API endpoints for listing frameworks, controls, requirements and monitoring tests are developer building blocks from which such a view could be built, not the view itself. The community note that people show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard concerns personnel compliance, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
